evidence.observation: H701 reads 328.512 °C while the other reboiler heater reads 65.962 °C and the vessel reads 55.606 °C; the large discrepancy requires verification.
The discrepancy persists: H701 is 332.960 °C, H702 is 67.323 °C, and the vessel is 57.119 °C. These readings cannot distinguish actual localized overheating from temperature-measurement error.
System pressure remains near its earlier value at 598.933 mbar; column and buffer pressure differences are 0.886 and 2.083 mbar. Distillate, reflux and cooling-water flows remain present.
Distillate flow briefly dropped to 0.004, recovering to 0.184 at 600 seconds; this does not establish a sustained flow failure.
